```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>", fig.width = 7, fig.height = 5)
library(pcaLab)
```

## Static figures

```{r eval=FALSE}
ex <- pca_example_agronomy()
fit <- pca_fit(ex$data,scale=TRUE,ncomp=5)
g <- pca_group(fit,ex$metadata$treatment,region="bootstrap",nboot=499,seed=1)

p1 <- pca_plot(fit,"scores",group=ex$metadata$treatment,group_region=g)
p2 <- pca_plot(fit,"correlation_circle")
p3 <- pca_plot(fit,"scree")

pca_export_plot(p1,"scores.pdf",width=7,height=5)
pca_export_plot(p2,"variables.svg",width=6,height=6)
pca_export_plot(p3,"scree.tiff",width=7,height=5,dpi=600)
```

The default theme is deliberately restrained and leaves color/palette decisions to the user or journal workflow.

## Interactive 3D scores

```{r eval=FALSE}
pca_plot(fit,type="scores3d",dims=c(1,2,3),group=ex$metadata$treatment)
```

## Tables

```{r eval=FALSE}
e <- pca_table(fit,"eigenvalues")
pca_export_table(e,"eigenvalues.xlsx")
pca_export_table(e,"eigenvalues.tex")
pca_export_table(e,"eigenvalues.docx")
```

## Reproducible report

```{r eval=FALSE}
sel <- pca_ncomp(fit,methods="all",nperm=499,nboot=200,seed=1)
test <- pca_test(fit,nperm=999,seed=1)
boot <- pca_boot(fit,nboot=999,seed=1)
pca_report(fit,"analysis.md",inference=test,selection=sel,bootstrap=boot)
```

## The publication theme

All static figures use `pca_theme_publication()`, which is exported so supplementary figures in a manuscript can reuse the same styling:

```{r}
fit <- pca_fit(iris[, 1:4], center = TRUE, scale = TRUE, ncomp = 3)
pca_plot(fit, "scree") + pca_theme_publication(12)
```
